newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai acid attacker gets death sentence.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai acid attacker gets death sentence.

text.p: A woman who threw sulphuric acid in the faces of the wife and daughter of her former lover has been sentenced to death, official media reported on Saturday.
Yang Yuxia was sentenced on Friday by Shanghai's Number Two Intermediate Court for intentionally causing grievous bodily harm to the mother and daughter, the Liberation Daily said.

Jilted by her lover, Yang waited outside his home and threw the acid into the faces of his wife Gu Xiaping and her eight-year-old daughter, blinding the child in both eyes, according to official media reports.

Shanghai television this week broadcast dramatic pictures of the trial, with a weeping and remorseful Yang in the accused's box a few metres (yards) from Gu, who was wrapped in bandages, her face horribly scarred.

Ding Shouxing, the court's deputy chief, said the death sentence was imposed according to law because Yang's crime was cruel and premeditated and constituted an attack on two innocent people, the Liberation Daily said.
An examination by specialists found Yang was not mentally disturbed when she carried out the crime, Ding said.
